verses.text: A Psalm of David. The earth is the LORD’s, and the fullness thereof, the world and all who dwell therein.

segments.text: A Psalm of David. The earth is the LORD’s, and the fullness thereof, the world and all who dwell therein.

verses.text: For He has founded it upon the seas and established it upon the waters.

segments.text: For He has founded it upon the seas and established it upon the waters.

verses.text: Who may ascend the hill of the LORD? Who may stand in His holy place?

segments.text: Who may ascend the hill of the LORD? Who may stand in His holy place?

verses.text: He who has clean hands and a pure heart, who does not lift up his soul to an idol or swear deceitfully.

segments.text: He who has clean hands and a pure heart, who does not lift up his soul to an idol or swear deceitfully.

verses.text: He will receive blessing from the LORD and vindication from the God of his salvation.

segments.text: He will receive blessing from the LORD and vindication from the God of his salvation.

verses.text: Such is the generation of those who seek Him, who seek Your face, O God of Jacob. Selah

segments.text: Such is the generation of those who seek Him, who seek Your face, O God of Jacob. Selah

verses.text: Lift up your heads, O gates! Be lifted up, O ancient doors, that the King of Glory may enter!

segments.text: Lift up your heads, O gates! Be lifted up, O ancient doors, that the King of Glory may enter!

verses.text: Who is this King of Glory? The LORD strong and mighty, the LORD mighty in battle.

segments.text: Who is this King of Glory? The LORD strong and mighty, the LORD mighty in battle.

verses.text: Lift up your heads, O gates! Be lifted up, O ancient doors, that the King of Glory may enter!

segments.text: Lift up your heads, O gates! Be lifted up, O ancient doors, that the King of Glory may enter!

verses.text: Who is He, this King of Glory? The LORD of Hosts—He is the King of Glory. Selah

segments.text: Who is He, this King of Glory? The LORD of Hosts—He is the King of Glory. Selah
